hooks.name: total-recall Session Start
hooks.description: Initializes the total-recall memory system at session start

action.prompt: Call the total-recall `session_start` MCP tool now, before anything else. This loads your pinned directives, hot-tier memories, and knowledge base context for this session. After it returns, briefly announce: tier counts from tierSummary, storage backend, and any hints. Keep it to 2-3 lines. Do not ask the user anything — just initialize and report.
